history.halt_reason: The witness installed process.on() listeners for SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP/SIGPIPE/SIGBREAK/SIGWINCH and for unhandledRejection + rejectionHandled. Per Node.js semantics, installing a listener removes Node's default disposition (terminate on SIGINT/SIGTERM) or for unhandled rejections (--unhandled-rejections=throw). The witness therefore could alter process-termination semantics - the exact authority it was meant to measure.

history.halt_addressed_summary: Removed beforeExit from the safe-list entirely. Per Node.js docs, a beforeExit listener may schedule asynchronous work (the witness's async writer() path qualifies) and cause the process to continue instead of exiting -- directly violating the witness's 'semantically inert' contract. The channel was also not load-bearing for TA1..TA6. Frozen safe-list is now exactly {exit, uncaughtExceptionMonitor, warning}.
